speak: Corporation's name.
Business number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year-end. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Amount 1A. Basic dividend allowance.

Amount 1B. Taxable dividends, other than excluded dividends, paid in the calendar year immediately preceding the calendar year in which the tax year ended. These dividends are on taxable preferred shares or shares that would be taxable preferred shares if they were issued after June 18, 1987, and were not grandfathered shares. See point 1 in Part 2 below if the corporation is associated.
Amount 1C.
Line 110. Excess, amount 1B minus amount 1C. If negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Line 110. Instance 2.
Line 115. Dividend allowance. Amount 1A minus line 110. If negative, enter 0.
Line 116. Date filed, do not use this area. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Line 117. Is this an amended agreement? Yes.
Line 117. Is this an amended agreement? No.
Line 118. Calendar year to which the agreement applies. Date. Year 4 digits.
Line 120. Name of each associated corporation. Row 1.
Line 130. Business number. If a corporation is not registered, enter NR. Row 1.
Line 140. Dividend allowance allocated. Row 1.
Line 120. Name of each associated corporation. Row 2.
Line 130. Business number. If a corporation is not registered, enter NR. Row 2.
Line 140. Dividend allowance allocated. Row 2.
Line 120. Name of each associated corporation. Row 3.
Line 130. Business number. If a corporation is not registered, enter NR. Row 3.
Line 140. Dividend allowance allocated. Row 3.
Line 120. Name of each associated corporation. Row 4.
Line 130. Business number. If a corporation is not registered, enter NR. Row 4.
Line 140. Dividend allowance allocated. Row 4.
Line 120. Name of each associated corporation. Row 5.
Line 130. Business number. If a corporation is not registered, enter NR. Row 5.
Line 140. Dividend allowance allocated. Row 5.
Total. Cannot be more than amount on line 115.
Line 210. Dividend allowance. Amount on line 115 from Part 1 or, if associated, the total amount allocated on line 140 from Part 2.
Line 220. Taxable dividends other than excluded dividends paid by the corporation in the year on short-term preferred shares.
Amount 3A. Line 210 or 220, whichever is less.
Amount 3B. Line 220 minus amount 3A.
Amount 3C. Amount 3B multiplied by 40 percent.

Line 230. Taxable dividends other than excluded dividends paid by the corporation in the year on taxable preferred shares other than short-term preferred shares of all classes for which the corporation is making an election under subsection 191.2(1).
Amount 3D. Dividend allowance, line 210.
Amount 3E. Amount 3A.
Amount 3F. Net amount. Amount 3D minus amount 3E.
Amount 3G. Line 230 or amount 3F, whichever is less.
Amount 3H. Line 230 minus amount 3G.
Amount 3I. Amount 3H multiplied by 40 percent.

Line 240. Taxable dividends other than excluded dividends paid by the corporation in the year on taxable preferred shares other than short-term preferred shares of all classes for which the corporation is not making an election under subsection 191.2(1).
Amount 3J. Dividend allowance. Line 210.
Amount 3K. Amount 3A.
Amount 3L. Amount 3G.
Amount 3M. Subtotal. Amount 3K plus amount 3L. Instance 1.
Amount 3M. Instance 2.
Amount 3N. Net amount. Amount 3J minus amount 3M.
Amount 3O. Line 240 or amount 3N, whichever is less.
Amount 3P. Line 240 minus amount 3O.
Amount 3Q. Amount 3P multiplied by 25 percent.
Line 250. Part VI.1 tax transferred from a related corporation.
Amount 3R. Subtotal. Add amounts 3C, 3I, 3Q, and line 250.
Line 260. Part VI.1 tax transferred to a related corporation.
Line 270. Part VI.1 tax payable. Amount 3R minus line 260. Enter amount from line 270 on line 724 of the T2 return.

Line 310. Taxable dividends other than excepted dividends received in the year on taxable preferred shares, other than a share of a class for which the corporation has made an election under subsection 191.2(1).
Line 320. Taxable dividends other than excepted dividends received in the year by a restricted financial institution on taxable restricted financial institution shares. See section 187.3.
Line 330. Total taxable dividends subject to Part IV.1 tax. Line 310 plus line 320.
Line 340. Part IV.1 tax payable. Line 330 multiplied by 10%. Enter amount from line 340 on line 716 of the T2 return.
Line 350. Portion of taxable dividends included in line 330 that is also subject to Part IV tax.
Line 370. Portion of taxable dividends included on line 350 received from connected corporations.
Line 380. Part IV tax on taxable dividends reported on line 370.
Amount 4A. Line 380 multiplied by 30 percent. Enter amount 4A at amount 2F of Schedule 3, Dividends Received, Taxable Dividends Paid, and Part IV Tax Calculations.
Line 390. Portion of taxable dividends included on line 350 received from non-connected corporations.
Amount 4B. Line 390 multiplied by 10 percent.
Line 360. Reduction of Part IV tax otherwise payable. Amount 4A plus amount 4B. Enter amount from line 360 on line 320 of Schedule 3.
Line 400. Eligible taxable dividends included on line 390.
Amount 4C. Line 400 multiplied by 10 percent. Enter amount 4C at amount 2I of Schedule 3.
Amount 4D. Part IV tax reduction of non-eligible taxable dividends received from non-connected corporations. Amount 4B minus amount 4C. Enter amount 4D at amount T of the T2 return.
